entries.text: Use editor context menus to format text and prepare a Skill for selected text. Hold Ctrl while choosing a Skill to send it immediately.

When an Article changes, its outdated suggestion leaves active review. You can inspect it as an earlier suggestion, keep writing with your replacement edits, or request an updated suggestion for the current Article.
Article rows show attention for running or failed Assistant requests, unseen replies, and work awaiting review, with labels explaining the reason.
Choose whether to disable interface dimming, animations, and transitions in General settings. Device reduced-motion preferences are still respected.
Update information identifies stable security releases and warns when an update may be incompatible.
Ctrl could be lost when choosing a Skill from editor actions, preventing immediate send. The Ctrl action now works from editor context menus.
Revision counts could be wrong for text containing Unicode characters. Counts now handle those characters correctly.
Fact Check could try to match claims against history entries with no material anchors. It now skips those impossible matches.
